name: Fetcher::fetch

test_list.description: Abort streaming immediately after the configured decoded byte limit is exceeded.
Reject a response whose media type is not explicitly allowed.
Enforce the redirect cap and apply SSRF checks to each new target.
Convert HTML to Markdown, remove non-visible active content, and mark it untrusted.
Decode the already byte-bounded response using its declared charset; unknown labels fall back to UTF-8 replacement decoding.
Reject legacy charset expansion and extracted Markdown that exceeds the configured output byte limit.
Reject user-agent values containing HTTP control characters during fetcher configuration.
Reject HTML trees exceeding fixed node-count or nesting-depth limits before recursive Markdown conversion.
Run parser and conversion on a blocking worker and retain the concurrency permit until it completes, including after caller deadline.
Keep the provider semaphore occupied while blocking conversion continues after the async call is cancelled or times out.
Enforce the total deadline and stop work when the calling future is cancelled.
Return a typed rate-limited error and update the shared limiter penalty on HTTP 429.

inputs.name: fetcher
inputs.description: Configured transport, concurrency limit, rate limiter, and byte/deadline policy.

output_description: A bounded, sanitized Markdown page with the final URL and an Untrusted trust label.
